remarks:
Hanover !!!!  Charming and beautifully cared-for, this adorable ranch-style home offers the best of both worlds: a peaceful country atmosphere while remaining conveniently close to everyday amenities and Sunset Beach. From the moment you arrive, the inviting covered front porch, complete with double benches, sets the tone for this warm and welcoming home.
Step inside to a spacious ceramic-tiled foyer featuring convenient wall hooks and plenty of room for coats, boots, and shoes. The bright, open-concept living and dining areas are enhanced by beautiful cathedral ceilings, creating an airy and comfortable space for both everyday living and entertaining.
The home offers two bedrooms, including a generously sized primary bedroom that does not have a closet, along with an updated full bath featuring a surround tub and ceramic tile flooring. A first-floor laundry area adds convenience, while a second entryway with a spacious nook provides additional functionality and storage.
Outside, enjoy a nicely sized wooded lot with a shed and a double-wide driveway, offering plenty of parking. Central air adds to the comfort, and convenient basement access is available through a large rear-yard door.
Full of charm, character, and thoughtful features, this inviting home is truly a must-see!
